statement: The recorded “unpaid, due” status is not safe to rely on or verified as correct because the payment history shows this invoice was paid in full on 3 September under reference PAY-2291, so I will hold it to prevent a duplicate payment.
judge_text:
WRONG

The answer asserts the "unpaid, due" status contradicts the record's own payment history ("paid in full on 3 September under reference PAY-2291") and would cause a duplicate payment.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
